title: The Unlikely Best Friends
opening: The learning package for The Unlikely Best Friends uses the chapter's themes such as The Unlikely Best Friends, observation, reasoning, application, evidence, reflection. Learners read or listen closely, infer meaning, discuss choices, use evidence from the chapter, and connect the learning with their own lives.
